codeReview.summary: Three well-structured reusable UI components with comprehensive test coverage (27 tests). Code follows biome.json style (tabs, single quotes, no semicolons). All expected behaviors from the feature description are implemented. Minor accessibility improvements recommended but not blocking.

issues.description: Table rows have tabIndex={0} and keyboard handlers but lack role='button' for proper screen reader semantics. Clickable rows should have explicit role to indicate interactivity.
Page indicator span (Page N of M) is not an ARIA live region. Screen readers won't be notified when page changes. Consider adding aria-live='polite' or aria-atomic='true'.

summary: PASS with minor accessibility notes. Components implement all expected behaviors: truncate-id shows first 8 chars with copy button, pagination has disabled states at boundaries, entity-table renders clickable rows with status badges. Tests cover all scenarios. Accessibility improvements recommended: add role='button' to clickable table rows and aria-live to pagination indicator.
